facts.text: Evidence from construction and mining supports simulated or generated training data as augmentation, not substitution, for machine-learning detection training.
facts.quote: The evidence supports augmentation, not substitution.

facts.text: The on-road automated-driving literature reaches the same conclusion as the construction and mining literature: simulated or generated training data supports augmentation, not substitution, for machine-learning detection training.
facts.quote: Two separate literatures, construction and mining on one side and on-road automated driving on the other, reach the same conclusion.
